dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Yes, a generous Vahu{RUBY#[S]Aetiology}mana researcher. He's very interested in the legends of King Deshret, and has helped many adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: My adventure this time has been sponsored by him. I'm here helping him look for someone at Caravan Ribat and pass on a message.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: But the girl he's looking for seemed to have received the Dusk Bird and gone to Sumeru City already. Did I get it wrong...?
